about.heading: About me
about.subheading: A little bit about who I am
about.bio:
I'm Aarav, a self-taught coder and developer from India. I love building things on the internet — from slick websites and web apps to Discord bots and automation tools.

When I'm not coding, you'll find me sharing my builds on Instagram, learning new tech, gaming, or planning my next big project.
